windows_actual_fixture.scope: One full offline check of already accepted Windows attempt1 artifacts using the strict initial checker. This preserves the original runtime results and is not another runtime invocation. The later clock-helper adjustment was tested separately below.

binding.basis: Artifact API has no run-attempt field. Bind the exact uploaded ID and size from this selected job log to the raw producer job API run_attempt. Both timestamps must be inside the job interval and within two seconds of the upload-step interval; original timestamps and measured offsets remain recorded.

bounded_upload_clock_preflight.scope: Only the artifact-upload binding helper was invoked on actual historical ARM job/API/log records, with mutations for rejection controls. No full ARM or Intel platform verifier pass is claimed.

provenance_contract.expected_run_attempt: Explicit CLI argument; both supplied raw run API and selected raw job must match.
provenance_contract.artifact_producer_attempt: Exact uploaded artifact ID and size from the selected producer job log plus raw job API attempt. API creation and upload-success timestamps remain inside the job interval and within a bounded 2-second margin of its upload-step interval. Original times and signed offsets are recorded.
provenance_contract.package_manifest: Source, workflow_run_id and platform are present; run_attempt is absent. Installer wrapper checks the supplied full run API attempt. Exact producer attempt additionally needs upload ID, producer job API and job log.
provenance_contract.retry_history: The intended Intel attempt2 requires the preserved source/run/target-matched original native failure record. Accepted Windows and ARM attempt1 artifacts remain attempt1.

limits: This record validates offline evidence parsing. It is not new runtime CI or renewed platform acceptance.
The full Windows preflight used the strict initial checker hash; the final current checker was exercised only through the two positive and three negative upload-binding helper fixtures.
The retry-only prior-failure branch was independently reviewed but has not been executed against actual Intel attempt2 evidence.
The current checker is source/run-specific. Its reviewed retry case is an Intel rerun following a native test failure with no installation bundle; it is not a general validator-only retry checker.
The original Intel attempt1 failure and scheduler-state rejection remain preserved separately; neither is overwritten or reclassified.
No full workflow success, signing/notarization, all-DAW compatibility or acoustic/hardware equivalence is asserted.
